# Fábrica de SaaS

> Catálogo verificado de SaaS open source (836 projetos em 37 categorias, licença e atividade conferidas no GitHub em 2026-10-27) mais 9 produtos próprios em MIT. Verified catalog of open source SaaS alternatives, plus 9 MIT products of our own.

O catálogo só aponta para os projetos; nada de terceiros é copiado. Fatos (licença SPDX, estrelas, último push) vêm da API do GitHub, descrições são nossas, em português e inglês. / The catalog only links to projects; facts come from the GitHub API, descriptions are ours.

## Dados / Data

- [catalogo.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thiagopatzdorf/fabrica-de-saas/main/catalogo.json): um objeto por projeto, com `meta` e esquema / one object per project
- [catalogo.csv](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thiagopatzdorf/fabrica-de-saas/main/catalogo.csv): a mesma tabela em CSV / same data as CSV
- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thiagopatzdorf/fabrica-de-saas/main/llms-full.txt): o catálogo inteiro, uma linha por projeto / full catalog, one line per project
- [schema/saas.schema.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thiagopatzdorf/fabrica-de-saas/main/schema/saas.schema.json): esquema JSON / JSON Schema

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thiagopatzdorf/fabrica-de-saas/main/AGENTS.md): como consultar, propor entradas e verificar localmente / how to query, propose entries and verify
- [LICENSE-POLICY.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thiagopatzdorf/fabrica-de-saas/main/LICENSE-POLICY.md): licenças aceitas e recusadas / accepted and rejected licenses
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thiagopatzdorf/fabrica-de-saas/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): como adicionar um SaaS / how to add a SaaS
- [docs/estatisticas.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thiagopatzdorf/fabrica-de-saas/main/docs/estatisticas.md): contagens / counts

## Código nosso / Our code

- [Gestão Jurídica](https://github.com/thiagopatzdorf/fabrica-de-saas/blob/main/apps/gestao-juridica): Law-firm management: cases (CNJ number validated), CPC deadlines, calendar, versioned documents, alerts and role-based login.
- [Links de Pagamento](https://github.com/thiagopatzdorf/fabrica-de-saas/blob/main/apps/links-de-pagamento): Payment links on your own Stripe account (fixed, free or monthly amounts; Pix, card, installments), branded checkout and signed webhook.
- [Loja Mínima](https://github.com/thiagopatzdorf/fabrica-de-saas/blob/main/apps/loja-minima): Small online store: storefront, cart, checkout, owner dashboard and shipping; the price is always recomputed on the server.
- [Hub de Marketplaces](https://github.com/thiagopatzdorf/fabrica-de-saas/blob/main/apps/hub-de-marketplaces): Multichannel e-commerce hub: catalog, price, stock, listings and orders. The channel adapters are SIMULATED.
- [Fitrich](https://github.com/thiagopatzdorf/fabrica-de-saas/blob/main/apps/fitrich): Personal finance plus workout/nutrition, 100% on-device (PWA, no backend), in Portuguese and English.
- [Banco de Questões](https://github.com/thiagopatzdorf/fabrica-de-saas/blob/main/apps/banco-de-questoes): Question bank for Brazilian public-service exams, with progress per subject and a "chance to pass" estimate.
- [Kanban de Equipe](https://github.com/thiagopatzdorf/fabrica-de-saas/blob/main/apps/kanban-de-equipe): Kanban, projects, team and a lightweight budget view; syncs GitHub Issues and ships an MCP server for AI agents.
- [PDV de Restaurante](https://github.com/thiagopatzdorf/fabrica-de-saas/blob/main/apps/pdv-restaurante): Restaurant point of sale: tables, orders, kitchen, cash register and bill splitting.
- [Migração de Legado](https://github.com/thiagopatzdorf/fabrica-de-saas/blob/main/apps/migracao-de-legado): Kit to move a legacy system: reads Delphi or Laravel, writes the business-rules contract and generates the new app.
